hotels.title: Romantic Lancemore Wine-Lovers' Escape in the Heart of the King Valley
hotels.description: Known as a foodie’s heaven and a wine connoisseur’s delight, the picturesque Lancemore Milawa offers visitors a breath of fresh country air in the gourmet King Valley region of Victoria’s beautiful High Country. Nestled amid lush countryside and rolling vineyards, the hotel provides the perfect opportunity to indulge, relax and explore the stunning scenery and local culinary scene. Ideally located only 2.5 hours' drive from Melbourne, the hotel is perfectly placed for exploring world-class epicurean hot spots such as the award-winning Milawa Cheese Company and the King Valley Prosecco Road, a haven of picturesque vineyards home to the iconic Brown Brothers winery. First-class onsite facilities include a gourmet restaurant, outdoor swimming pool and a cosy wood fireplace to ensure a romantic escape year-round.

hotels.title: Boutique King Valley Vineyard Escape with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Drinks & Wine Tastings
hotels.description: Discover Victoria’s beautiful High Country with a romantic escape among the vineyards of the King Valley gourmet food and wine region. Ideally located three hours' drive from Melbourne, this elegant hotel is perfectly placed for an indulgent getaway, with world-class epicurean hot spots on its doorstep. Overlooking picture-perfect gardens, each elegant room is designed to bring the beauty of the outside in. First-class facilities include a sauna and outdoor swimming pool, plus a cosy wood fireplace for a romantic year-round retreat. The onsite Merlot Restaurant Bar boasts floor-to-ceiling windows and celebrates the region’s finest artisanal producers. When it's time to venture out, spend an afternoon cruising the famous King Valley Prosecco Road or pop into local breweries to sample intriguing craft brews. The quaint High Country towns of Bright and Beechworth also make for easy day trips through lush countryside.
